description: This Java class 'DefaultStreamStageConfig' provides a configuration implementation for stream stage settings, including parallelism and exponential backoff configurations, with a static factory method to instantiate it from a configuration object.

classes.name: DefaultStreamStageConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of StreamStageConfig providing stream stage parameters such as parallelism and exponential backoff configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of DefaultStreamStageConfig from a given Config and config path.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the configured level of parallelism for the stream stage.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Returns the exponential backoff configuration used in the stream stage.
